anchor_value: embedded schedule header, not a portfolio position

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Portfolio Company | Investment Type (1)(2) | Interest | Acq. Date | Maturity Date | Principal Amount | Cost | Fair Value | % of Net Assets * | Notes

findings.detail: An embedded repeated schedule header was treated as a candidate investment row, leaving the Principal Amount header text in the principal amount field.

rationale: The only localized malformed principal-amount evidence in raw source is table 102 row 30, which is a repeated column header inside the schedule, not an investment. The following rows restart the section with Control Investments, Debt Investments, Aerospace & Defense, and then the actual Skyvault Holdings LLC debt row with a numeric $5,738 principal amount. Treating the header text Principal Amount as a principal amount is therefore a real row-filtering/extraction defect.
